title_zh: 商定由队长赛后向裁判询问

scenario.label_zh: 足球赛后异议沟通边界
scenario.goal_zh: 听取对判罚的不满，约定不与对手争执而由队长赛后私下询问裁判

context_zh: 业余足球比赛暂停时，队长劝队员避免现场争吵。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: The referee gave them the ball again. Their player touched it last.

sentences.speaker: Rafi
sentences.text: I saw it differently, but arguing now will not help us play.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: The rival captain is smiling at me. He knows what happened.

sentences.speaker: Rafi
sentences.text: You don't know what he is thinking. Try to resist the temptation to shout at him.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: Will you ask about the decision after the match?

sentences.speaker: Rafi
sentences.text: Yes. As captain, I'll speak to the referee privately. For now, let's get back into position.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: All right. I'll leave it with you and focus on the game.
